noResults.title: No requests match these filters
noResults.body: Try a nearby municipality or remove a blood-type filter. Requests change often — check back later.

noSaved.title: You haven’t saved any requests
noSaved.body: Save a request to follow its status. We’ll show updates here — saving doesn’t commit you to anything.

networkError.title: Can’t load requests right now
networkError.body: You may be offline. We’ll keep what’s on screen; nothing you entered is lost.

mapUnavailable.title: The map couldn’t load
mapUnavailable.body: The list still works. Map tiles come from OpenStreetMap and may be temporarily unreachable.

requestUnavailable.title: This request is no longer active
requestUnavailable.body: It expired on {{date}} at {{time}} and isn’t accepting responses. Look for active requests nearby instead.
